headline: Weathered Expanse Draws Even; Linn Mercy Post Goes Neutral
war_summary: Since the last edition, Farranac Coast now reports all eleven positions in Colonial hands, erasing the Warden and neutral spots seen earlier. Fishermans Row, split in the previous wire, is likewise fully Colonial once more after sharp activity at Black Well, Dankana Post, Fort Ember, and Eidolo. Linn Mercy no longer stands as a solid Colonial bloc: one position is neutral among ten Colonial, with Lathair and Rotdust still figuring in the returns. Weathered Expanse has moved from six Warden posts and three Colonial to four and four, with one position neutral, and Crow's Nest and Frostmarch remain the busiest names. Stonecradle's ledger still shows three Warden posts to six Colonial, while Stlican Shelf remains five to four; the Thornhold wire has gone quiet. Gutter is entirely Warden, with The Parras recording an unusually active sheet. Casualty counts in the last day are steepest at Stonecradle and Weathered Expanse, with enlistment accelerating at Fishermans Row and Farranac Coast. War 140 remains undecided: no side has taken the thirty-four victory towns required.
